script_text: The stars are colliding for Leo as the Sun enters your relationship house igniting your Fire, sparking a shift you can't ignore. Today the Sun enters your 7th House joining Mercury forcing you to confront every partnership head-on. Monday through Wednesday demands honest dialogue but Mercury square Saturn Tuesday creates friction around money matters in relationships. Wednesday brings the turning point as Venus enters your 7th House lighting up romance with a Venus trine to Jupiter that feels magical. Thursday onward shifts toward career as the Moon enters your 10th House. Weekend surprises bring career recognition via Moon trine Pluto. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 7th House supercharging love. Friday is your warning day because Mercury squares Saturn threatening finances. Speak your truth in partnerships this week — the Sun in your 7th House demands you listen. Follow for your daily updates.
